notes: «رجل من أصحابنا يلقب بسكباج»: the text gives only a laqab, so the laqab is the surface and the unnamed phrase is dropped
«صاحب الأتراك» is an epithet of Ahmad and «كان يقوم بببعض أمور الماضي» a description: both left out; the Imam al-Madi is not added
«قال يوماً» does not settle whether Ahmad or the Imam speaks; no speaker is added (rule 6, rule 11)

fixes.reason: RWY records the man as a bare «رجل» with no name; the text gives him a laqab (سكباج), which the reader keeps as his surface.
